title: Fix login authentication bug
description: Users are unable to log in using correct credentials. JWT token validation is failing on the server side.

title: Add unit tests for payment module
description: Payment processing functions lack test coverage. Need to add unit tests for all edge cases.

title: Set up CI/CD pipeline
description: Configure GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment to staging environment.

title: Migrate database to PostgreSQL
description: Current MySQL setup has performance issues. Migrate all tables and data to PostgreSQL.

title: Fix CORS policy on API endpoints
description: Frontend is getting CORS errors when calling the REST API from different origins.

title: Add password reset functionality
description: Users cannot reset forgotten passwords. Need email-based password reset flow.

title: Optimise slow database queries
description: Several API endpoints are timing out due to unoptimised SQL queries missing indexes.

title: Write API documentation
description: REST API endpoints are undocumented. Add OpenAPI/Swagger docs for all routes.

title: Fix session timeout bug
description: User sessions expire too early even when the user is actively using the app.

title: Add rate limiting to API
description: API endpoints have no rate limiting. Need to add per-IP and per-user request throttling.

title: Implement user role management
description: Application lacks role-based access control. Need admin, editor, and viewer roles.

title: Fix memory leak in background worker
description: Background job processor is consuming increasing memory over time and needs investigation.

title: Add integration tests for auth flow
description: Authentication flow has no integration tests. Cover login, logout, and token refresh.

title: Set up monitoring and alerting
description: No monitoring in place for production. Set up Prometheus metrics and PagerDuty alerts.

title: Refactor user registration flow
description: Registration code is duplicated across multiple files. Consolidate into a single service.

title: Add input sanitisation to forms
description: User input forms are vulnerable to XSS attacks. Add proper sanitisation and validation.

title: Upgrade outdated dependencies
description: Several npm and pip packages have known security vulnerabilities and need upgrading.

title: Add lazy loading to frontend
description: All components load at startup causing slow initial page load. Implement code splitting.

title: Fix Docker container startup order
description: Services start in wrong order causing connection errors on fresh docker-compose up.

title: Add search functionality
description: Users cannot search through records. Implement full-text search using PostgreSQL.

title: Write deployment documentation
description: No documentation exists for deploying the application to production. Create runbook.

title: Fix broken email notifications
description: Transactional emails are not being sent. SMTP configuration appears misconfigured.

title: Add export to CSV feature
description: Users want to export their data as CSV files. Add download endpoint for all data tables.

title: Implement caching layer
description: Frequently accessed data is fetched from DB on every request. Add Redis caching.

title: Fix responsive design on mobile
description: Dashboard is not usable on mobile screens. Fix layout and touch interactions.

title: Add two-factor authentication
description: Account security needs improvement. Implement TOTP-based two-factor authentication.

title: Resolve flaky test suite
description: About 20% of tests fail randomly in CI. Investigate and fix timing and isolation issues.

title: Add pagination to list endpoints
description: API returns all records at once causing slow responses. Add cursor-based pagination.

title: Set up log aggregation
description: Logs are scattered across services. Set up centralised logging with ELK stack.

title: Fix file upload size limit
description: Large file uploads are being rejected silently. Fix server and nginx upload size limits.

title: Add dark mode to dashboard
description: Users have requested a dark mode option. Implement theme toggle using CSS variables.

title: Fix race condition in order processing
description: Concurrent order submissions sometimes result in duplicate charges. Add distributed lock.

title: Add webhook support
description: Partners need to receive real-time event notifications. Implement outbound webhooks.

title: Optimise image loading
description: Product images load slowly. Implement WebP conversion and CDN delivery.

title: Fix broken OAuth integration
description: Sign in with Google is returning 500 errors. OAuth callback URL is misconfigured.

title: Add audit logging
description: No record of who changed what. Implement audit trail for all data mutations.

title: Refactor API error handling
description: Error responses are inconsistent across endpoints. Standardise error format and codes.

title: Add end-to-end tests
description: No E2E test coverage exists. Add Playwright tests for critical user journeys.

title: Fix SSL certificate renewal
description: SSL certificate expires soon and auto-renewal is not configured. Set up certbot.

title: Add user activity dashboard
description: Admins need visibility into user activity. Build analytics dashboard with charts.

title: Implement soft delete for records
description: Deleted records are permanently removed. Implement soft delete with restore capability.

title: Fix timezone handling
description: Dates display incorrectly for users in different timezones. Standardise to UTC storage.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts
description: Power users want keyboard shortcuts for common actions. Implement shortcut system.

title: Fix broken data migration script
description: The v2 migration script fails on large datasets. Fix memory usage and add checkpointing.

title: Add multi-language support
description: International users need localisation. Add i18n framework and translate to 3 languages.

title: Resolve dependency conflict in backend
description: Two packages require conflicting versions of a shared library causing import errors.

title: Add backup and restore system
description: No automated backup exists for the database. Set up daily backups with restore testing.

title: Fix navigation breadcrumbs
description: Breadcrumb trail shows incorrect paths on nested pages. Fix routing logic.

title: Implement feature flags system
description: Need ability to toggle features without deployment. Set up feature flag service.

title: Add performance profiling
description: Application performance degrades under load. Set up profiling to identify bottlenecks.
